skills.name: Order picture steps
skills.description: Put 3-4 picture cards of an everyday task in the right order, e.g. put on socks before shoes.

skills.name: Pick the next step
skills.description: Given the first steps of a routine, choose what comes next, e.g. after 'pour cereal' comes 'add milk'.

skills.name: Move the robot
skills.description: Choose the arrow command (up, down, left, right) that moves a robot one square toward a star on a tiny grid.

skills.name: Continue a pattern
skills.description: Pick the shape or colour that comes next in a repeating pattern such as red, blue, red, blue, ?.

skills.name: Sort by one rule
skills.description: Drag objects into two groups by one attribute, e.g. things with wheels and things without.

skills.name: Find the odd one out
skills.description: Spot the item that does not belong in a group, e.g. a cat among three fruits.

skills.name: Name computer parts
skills.description: Match pictures of screen, keyboard, mouse and tablet to their names.

skills.name: Is it a computer?
skills.description: Sort everyday objects into 'has a computer inside' (phone, washing machine) and 'does not' (spoon, chair).

skills.name: Buttons and screens
skills.description: Choose whether a part is something you touch (keyboard, mouse) or something that shows or plays (screen, speaker).

skills.name: Count with tallies
skills.description: Count how many of each item appear in a picture and give the number, e.g. 4 red apples.

skills.name: Read a picture graph
skills.description: Look at a picture graph and answer which row has the most or how many icons it shows.

skills.name: Pick the tool for the job
skills.description: Choose which device helps with a task, e.g. a camera to take a photo or a phone to call grandma.

skills.name: Then and now
skills.description: Match an old way of doing something (writing a letter) with its digital way (sending a message).

skills.name: Ask a trusted adult
skills.description: Decide whether a situation needs a grown-up, e.g. a pop-up appears asking for your name: yes, ask an adult.

skills.name: Keep private things private
skills.description: Sort facts into 'okay to share online' (favourite colour) and 'keep private' (home address).

skills.name: Screen time balance
skills.description: Choose healthy habits like taking a break after playing, or sitting far from the screen.

skills.name: Build a step list
skills.description: Assemble 4-6 steps for a task like making a sandwich, leaving out steps that do not belong.

skills.name: Find the missing step
skills.description: Spot which step is missing from a routine, e.g. brushing teeth without 'put toothpaste on brush'.

skills.name: Plan a grid path
skills.description: Build a list of arrow moves that takes a character to a goal on a 3x3 or 4x4 grid while avoiding one obstacle.

skills.name: Count the repeats
skills.description: Tell how many times a chunk repeats in a pattern, e.g. clap-stomp happens 3 times.

skills.name: Shorten with repeat
skills.description: Replace a long list like forward, forward, forward with 'repeat 3: forward'.

skills.name: Spot the bug
skills.description: Find the one wrong arrow in a short path program that makes the robot miss the goal.

skills.name: Hardware or software
skills.description: Sort items into hardware (mouse, printer) and software (drawing app, game).

skills.name: Input, output, process
skills.description: Label a part as input (keyboard), output (speaker) or the thinking part (processor).

skills.name: Simple fixes
skills.description: Choose the first thing to try when a device misbehaves, e.g. no sound: check the volume.

skills.name: Tally to bar chart
skills.description: Match tally counts to the bar chart that shows them correctly.

skills.name: Read a bar chart
skills.description: Answer questions from a bar chart, e.g. how many more children chose dogs than cats.

skills.name: Sort by two rules
skills.description: Place objects into a 2x2 grid by two attributes, e.g. big/small and striped/plain.

skills.name: Ways to send a message
skills.description: Choose how a message travels, e.g. a video call needs the internet while shouting across a room does not.

skills.name: Code and decode
skills.description: Use a simple picture or number key to decode a short message, e.g. 1=A, 2=B.

skills.name: Kind online words
skills.description: Pick the kind reply to a classmate's drawing and reject the mean one.

skills.name: Passwords stay secret
skills.description: Decide who you may tell a password to: a parent yes, a friend no.

skills.name: Messages from strangers
skills.description: Choose the safe action when someone you do not know sends a message: do not reply, tell an adult.

skills.name: Sequences
skills.description: Arrange move and turn blocks so a robot collects every gem on a grid, e.g. forward, forward, turn right, forward.

skills.name: Repeat loops
skills.description: Use a 'repeat N' block to shorten a program, e.g. repeat 4: forward, turn right draws a square.

skills.name: Predict the output
skills.description: Read a short block program and choose where the sprite ends up or what it draws.

skills.name: Event triggers action
skills.description: Match an event block (when key pressed, when clicked) to the action that should follow in a game.

skills.name: Sprite movement
skills.description: Pick the block that moves a sprite the asked way, e.g. 'change x by 10' moves it right.

skills.name: Parts and their jobs
skills.description: Match CPU, memory, storage and screen to what each does, e.g. storage keeps files when power is off.

skills.name: Files and folders
skills.description: Choose the right action to save, open or organise a file, e.g. put drawings in a 'Pictures' folder.

skills.name: Troubleshooting steps
skills.description: Order simple troubleshooting steps: check the cable, restart, then ask for help.

skills.name: Data for a question
skills.description: Pick which data to collect to answer a question, e.g. favourite fruit survey to plan a snack.

skills.name: Pictograph vs bar chart
skills.description: Read a chart with a scale (one icon = 2 votes) and give the actual total.

skills.name: Find a pattern in data
skills.description: Look at a small table and choose the true statement, e.g. more rain fell every month.

skills.name: Connected devices
skills.description: Sort devices into 'needs the internet to work' (video chat) and 'does not' (calculator).

skills.name: A message's journey
skills.description: Order the stops a message makes: your tablet, Wi-Fi router, internet, friend's phone.

skills.name: Strong passwords
skills.description: Choose the strongest password from a list, e.g. 'Purple7Tiger!' beats '1234'.

skills.name: Personal information
skills.description: Sort details into safe to share (favourite game) and never share (school name, phone number).

skills.name: Ask before posting
skills.description: Decide whether a photo of a friend may be posted without asking: no, ask first.

skills.name: If and if-else
skills.description: Use 'if path ahead' or 'if touching wall' blocks so a robot handles branching grids, e.g. if gem ahead then collect else turn.

skills.name: Debugging
skills.description: Find and fix the single wrong block in a program that fails, e.g. repeat 3 should be repeat 4.

skills.name: Nested repeats
skills.description: Predict the result of a repeat inside a repeat, e.g. repeat 2 of repeat 3 forward moves 6 squares.

skills.name: Track a value
skills.description: Follow a variable through a program, e.g. score starts 0, add 5 three times, score is 15.

skills.name: Choose what to store
skills.description: Pick which value a game needs a variable for, e.g. lives remaining, not the background colour.

skills.name: Inside the box
skills.description: Match CPU, RAM, hard drive and graphics card to a job description.

skills.name: What the operating system does
skills.description: Choose which tasks the operating system handles, e.g. starting apps and managing files.

skills.name: Hardware or software problem
skills.description: Decide whether a symptom is likely hardware (cracked screen) or software (app freezes) and pick a fix.

skills.name: Tables and columns
skills.description: Read a data table and find the value at a given row and column, e.g. Tuesday's temperature.

skills.name: Choose the chart
skills.description: Pick the best chart for a purpose, e.g. a line chart to show change over time.

skills.name: On and off: binary
skills.description: Convert small numbers to 4-bit binary and back, e.g. 5 is 0101.

skills.name: Parts of a network
skills.description: Match router, server, cable and Wi-Fi to their roles in getting a web page to you.

skills.name: Search keywords
skills.description: Choose the best search words for a question, e.g. 'tallest mountain Africa' instead of a full sentence.

skills.name: Read a web address
skills.description: Identify parts of a URL such as the domain and whether .org or .com, and spot a misspelt fake address.

skills.name: Helps and hurts
skills.description: Sort effects of a technology into positive and negative, e.g. video calls connect family but screens tire eyes.

skills.name: Accessibility tools
skills.description: Match tools like screen readers and captions to the people they help.

skills.name: Responding to cyberbullying
skills.description: Choose the right response to a mean message: do not reply, save it, tell a trusted adult.

skills.name: Digital footprint
skills.description: Decide whether a post leaves a lasting trace and whether you would want it seen in 5 years.

skills.name: Giving credit
skills.description: Decide when to credit a picture or text you use from the web, and pick the right way to do it.

skills.name: Functions
skills.description: Define a reusable block such as F1 = forward, turn left and call it several times to solve a grid with a small block budget.

skills.name: Combine loops, ifs and functions
skills.description: Solve a level that needs a loop containing an if and a function call, or predict what such a program does.

skills.name: Trace variables in loops
skills.description: Follow a variable changed inside a loop, e.g. total starts 2 and doubles 3 times to reach 16.

skills.name: Decompose a problem
skills.description: Break a project into parts and order them, e.g. a maze game needs a player, walls, a goal and a win check.

skills.name: Compare two solutions
skills.description: Given two programs that both work, choose the shorter or clearer one and say why.

skills.name: Read a flowchart
skills.description: Follow a flowchart with a decision diamond and tell the output for a given input.

skills.name: Guess-the-number search
skills.description: Pick the best next guess when searching 1-100 with higher/lower clues, e.g. start at 50.

skills.name: Input to output flow
skills.description: Order how a key press becomes a letter on screen: keyboard, CPU, memory, display.

skills.name: Storage sizes
skills.description: Compare kilobytes, megabytes and gigabytes, e.g. which holds more: 500 MB or 1 GB.

skills.name: Diagnose a problem
skills.description: Match a symptom (slow computer, no internet) to the most likely cause and first fix.

skills.name: 8-bit binary
skills.description: Convert numbers up to 255 between decimal and binary, e.g. 10 is 00001010.

skills.name: Pixels and images
skills.description: Decode a tiny black-and-white image from a grid of 1s and 0s or choose the grid that matches a picture.

skills.name: Summarise data
skills.description: Compute the mean, mode or range of a small data set and pick the claim the data supports.

skills.name: Packets
skills.description: Explain that messages are split into packets and reassembled; order the packets by their numbers.

skills.name: Evaluate a website
skills.description: Choose the more reliable source for a school report, e.g. a museum site over an anonymous blog.

skills.name: Ads versus content
skills.description: Spot which parts of a page are advertisements or sponsored results.

skills.name: How jobs change
skills.description: Match a technology to how it changed a job, e.g. GPS and delivery drivers.

skills.name: Designing for everyone
skills.description: Choose the design change that makes an app usable by more people, e.g. adding captions or larger buttons.

skills.name: Privacy settings
skills.description: Pick the setting that keeps a profile private, e.g. friends only instead of public.

skills.name: Spot a scam
skills.description: Identify warning signs in a message, e.g. 'You won a prize, click now!' with a strange link.

skills.name: Healthy tech habits
skills.description: Choose habits that support sleep and focus, e.g. no screens 30 minutes before bed.

skills.name: Blocks to text
skills.description: Match a block program to the equivalent text code, e.g. 'repeat 3' to 'for i in range(3):'.

skills.name: Variables and types
skills.description: Identify whether a value is a number, string or boolean and predict the result of simple assignments.

skills.name: Trace counting loops
skills.description: Give the printed output of a loop such as for i in range(1, 4): print(i * 2).

skills.name: Spot syntax errors
skills.description: Find the line with a missing colon, bracket or quote in a 3-5 line program.

skills.name: Read pseudocode
skills.description: Follow pseudocode with IF and WHILE and state its output for an input.

skills.name: Linear search
skills.description: Count how many items a linear search checks to find a target in a list.

skills.name: Sorting by hand
skills.description: Perform one pass of bubble sort or selection sort on 4-5 numbers and give the result.

skills.name: CPU, memory, storage
skills.description: Match components to their layers: CPU executes, RAM holds running programs, storage keeps files.

skills.name: Layers of software
skills.description: Order layers from hardware to operating system to applications.

skills.name: Systematic troubleshooting
skills.description: Choose the next diagnostic step that isolates a cause, e.g. test with another cable before replacing the monitor.

skills.name: Binary addition
skills.description: Add two 4-bit binary numbers, e.g. 0101 + 0011 = 1000.

skills.name: Text as numbers
skills.description: Use an ASCII table to encode or decode a short word, e.g. 72 101 is 'He'.

skills.name: Colours as numbers
skills.description: Match RGB triples to colours, e.g. (255, 0, 0) is red.

skills.name: Spreadsheet formulas
skills.description: Compute what a simple formula returns, e.g. =SUM(A1:A3) for given cells.

skills.name: IP addresses
skills.description: Recognise a valid IPv4 address and explain it identifies a device, e.g. 192.168.1.5.

skills.name: Domain names
skills.description: Order the steps when you type a web address: DNS lookup, request to server, response, render.

skills.name: Wired and wireless
skills.description: Compare Wi-Fi, Ethernet and mobile data for speed, range and reliability.

skills.name: Digital divide
skills.description: Identify how unequal access to devices and internet affects learning and work.

skills.name: Automation
skills.description: Sort tasks into easily automated (sorting mail) and hard to automate (comforting a friend).

skills.name: Fact-checking
skills.description: Choose the best way to verify a surprising claim, e.g. find two independent reliable sources.

skills.name: Phishing
skills.description: Spot phishing clues in an email: urgent tone, mismatched sender, link to a lookalike domain.

skills.name: Account security
skills.description: Pick practices that protect accounts: unique passwords, two-factor authentication, logging out on shared devices.

skills.name: Boolean conditions
skills.description: Evaluate expressions with and, or, not and comparisons, e.g. (x > 3) and (x < 10) when x = 5.

skills.name: While loops
skills.description: Trace a while loop and give how many times it runs or its final variable value.

skills.name: Functions with parameters
skills.description: Predict the return value of a small function call, e.g. def area(w, h): return w * h; area(3, 4).

skills.name: Fix a logic bug
skills.description: Choose the correction for code that runs but gives wrong output, e.g. < should be <=.

skills.name: Indexing
skills.description: Give the element at an index, e.g. nums = [4, 7, 9]; nums[1] is 7, and handle zero-based counting.

skills.name: Loop over a list
skills.description: Predict the output of a for loop that sums or filters list items.

skills.name: String operations
skills.description: Evaluate string length, concatenation and upper/lower, e.g. len('hello') is 5.

skills.name: Fetch-decode-execute
skills.description: Order the steps of the CPU cycle and identify what each does.

skills.name: Compare specifications
skills.description: Pick the device that fits a need from spec sheets, e.g. more RAM for video editing.

skills.name: Embedded systems
skills.description: Identify sensors, processors and actuators in a device like a thermostat or microwave.

skills.name: Hexadecimal
skills.description: Convert between binary, decimal and hex, e.g. 255 is FF.

skills.name: Filter and sort data
skills.description: Apply a filter and a sort to a small table and give the first row that remains.

skills.name: Charts and claims
skills.description: Decide whether a chart supports a claim and spot misleading axes.

skills.name: Compression
skills.description: Apply run-length encoding to a short string, e.g. AAABB becomes 3A2B.

skills.name: Clients and servers
skills.description: Identify request and response in a web interaction and what HTTP status like 404 means.

skills.name: Routing and redundancy
skills.description: Choose why packets may take different paths and still arrive, e.g. a router is down.

skills.name: HTML structure
skills.description:
Match HTML tags to what they display, e.g.

is a heading, an image.

skills.name: Bias in algorithms
skills.description: Identify how biased training data leads to unfair results, e.g. a face filter that fails on dark skin.

skills.name: Copyright and licences
skills.description: Sort uses of media into allowed and not allowed under copyright, Creative Commons and fair use.

skills.name: How apps track you
skills.description: Identify what cookies, location and permissions reveal and choose settings to limit tracking.

skills.name: Online reputation
skills.description: Judge how a post could be read by a future school or employer and pick a better version.

skills.name: Persuasive design
skills.description: Spot features designed to keep you scrolling, e.g. infinite feeds and streaks, and choose a counter-habit.

skills.name: Nested loops and ifs
skills.description: Trace a loop containing an if or another loop and give the output, e.g. count pairs where i < j.

skills.name: Dictionaries and key-value pairs
skills.description: Look up and update values in a dictionary, e.g. ages['Ana'] after ages['Ana'] += 1.

skills.name: Assemble a function
skills.description: Order given lines to build a working function, e.g. def is_even(n): return n % 2 == 0.

skills.name: Test cases
skills.description: Choose the test input that would reveal a bug, e.g. an empty list or zero.

skills.name: Binary search
skills.description: Count the steps binary search needs on a sorted list of n items, e.g. 16 items need at most 4 checks.

skills.name: Compare efficiency
skills.description: Decide which of two approaches does fewer steps as data grows, e.g. linear vs binary search.

skills.name: Recursion idea
skills.description: Trace a simple recursive function such as factorial(4) or countdown and give its result.

skills.name: Logic gates
skills.description: Give the output of AND, OR, NOT and XOR gates for given inputs or complete a truth table.

skills.name: Combine gates
skills.description: Evaluate a two-gate circuit, e.g. NOT(A AND B) with A=1, B=1 gives 0.

skills.name: Cloud and remote computing
skills.description: Explain what runs locally vs on a server for cloud apps and choose the trade-offs.

skills.name: File formats
skills.description: Match formats to uses, e.g. CSV for tables, PNG for lossless images, MP3 for compressed audio.

skills.name: Models and simulations
skills.description: Predict how changing a parameter in a simple model changes its output, e.g. more predators means fewer prey.

skills.name: Correlation is not causation
skills.description: Identify when two variables move together without one causing the other and name a possible confounder.

skills.name: Build an HTML page
skills.description: Order tags to form a valid page skeleton: html, head, title, body, h1, p.

skills.name: CSS basics
skills.description: Match a CSS rule to its effect, e.g. color: red makes text red, not the background.

skills.name: Links and paths
skills.description: Choose the correct href for a page in the same or a parent folder, e.g. ../about.html.

skills.name: Caesar cipher
skills.description: Encrypt or decrypt a word with a shift, e.g. shift 3 turns HELLO into KHOOR.

skills.name: Types of threats
skills.description: Match malware, phishing, brute force and social engineering to example scenarios.

skills.name: HTTPS and padlocks
skills.description: Explain what the padlock means and when to avoid entering data on a site.

skills.name: Computing careers
skills.description: Match job titles like data analyst, UX designer and network engineer to their daily tasks.

skills.name: How misinformation spreads
skills.description: Identify why false posts spread fast (emotion, algorithms) and choose actions that slow it.

skills.name: E-waste and energy
skills.description: Choose actions that reduce computing's environmental cost, e.g. repairing devices and recycling.

skills.name: Expressions and types
skills.description: Evaluate expressions with integer division, modulo and type conversion, e.g. 7 // 2 and int('3') + 2.

skills.name: Loops and accumulators
skills.description: Trace code that accumulates a sum, count or max over a range or list and give the result.

skills.name: Functions and scope
skills.description: Predict output involving local vs global variables and return values.

skills.name: String methods and slicing
skills.description: Evaluate slices and methods, e.g. 'python'[1:4] is 'yth' and 'a,b'.split(',').

skills.name: Sorting algorithms
skills.description: Show the list after k passes of bubble, selection or insertion sort.

skills.name: Growth rates
skills.description: Classify a loop structure as constant, linear or quadratic, e.g. nested loops over n are O(n^2).

skills.name: Trace tables
skills.description: Fill a trace table for a short algorithm and report a variable's final value.

skills.name: Signed integers
skills.description: Convert between decimal and 8-bit two's complement, e.g. -3 is 11111101.

skills.name: Memory hierarchy
skills.description: Order cache, RAM, SSD and cloud by speed or capacity and explain the trade-off.

skills.name: Processes and the OS
skills.description: Identify operating system jobs: scheduling processes, managing memory, handling files and devices.

skills.name: List operations
skills.description: Predict a list after append, insert, pop and slicing operations.

skills.name: 2D lists
skills.description: Read a value from grid[row][col] or count items in a 2D list.

skills.name: Counting with dictionaries
skills.description: Give the dictionary produced by counting letters or words in a short string.

skills.name: Semantic HTML
skills.description: Choose the right element for content, e.g. <nav> for navigation links, <ul> for a list.

skills.name: CSS selectors
skills.description: Decide which elements a selector targets, e.g. .card p matches paragraphs inside .card.

skills.name: JavaScript and the DOM
skills.description: Predict what a click handler does, e.g. button.addEventListener('click', ...) changing textContent.

skills.name: Protocol layers
skills.description: Match protocols to layers and roles, e.g. TCP ensures delivery, IP addresses, HTTP carries web pages.

skills.name: TCP vs UDP
skills.description: Choose the protocol for a use case, e.g. UDP for live video, TCP for a file download.

skills.name: Addresses and ports
skills.description: Identify what a port number does and read an address like 10.0.0.4:443.

skills.name: Confidentiality, integrity, availability
skills.description: Classify an incident as a breach of confidentiality, integrity or availability.

skills.name: Symmetric and public-key encryption
skills.description: Decide which key encrypts and which decrypts in a scenario, e.g. encrypt with the receiver's public key.

skills.name: Hashing and passwords
skills.description: Explain why sites store hashes not passwords and what salting prevents.

skills.name: Privacy rights
skills.description: Match data rights such as access, deletion and consent to scenarios under laws like GDPR.

skills.name: Ethical dilemmas
skills.description: Weigh stakeholders in a scenario, e.g. a school app tracking location, and pick the most defensible choice.

skills.name: Evaluate online sources
skills.description: Apply lateral reading to rate a source's reliability and spot sponsored or AI-generated content.

skills.name: Classes and objects
skills.description: Predict attribute values after constructing objects and calling methods on a small class.

skills.name: Inheritance
skills.description: Decide which method runs when a subclass overrides a parent method, e.g. Dog.speak over Animal.speak.

skills.name: Exceptions
skills.description: Predict what prints when code raises and catches errors with try/except.

skills.name: Modules and libraries
skills.description: Choose the right import and call for a task, e.g. random.randint(1, 6) for a dice roll.

skills.name: Stacks and queues
skills.description: Give the contents after a series of push/pop or enqueue/dequeue operations.

skills.name: Sets and hash tables
skills.description: Predict set operations and explain why lookup is fast, e.g. {1,2,3} & {2,3,4}.

skills.name: Linked lists
skills.description: Trace insertion and deletion in a singly linked list and give the resulting order.

skills.name: Choose a structure
skills.description: Pick the best data structure for a need, e.g. undo history uses a stack.

skills.name: Recursive functions
skills.description: Trace recursive calls such as fib(5) or sum of digits and give the result or call count.

skills.name: Merge sort
skills.description: Show the merge of two sorted halves or the state after one level of splitting.

skills.name: Big-O analysis
skills.description: Assign Big-O to code snippets and common algorithms, e.g. binary search is O(log n).

skills.name: Tables and keys
skills.description: Identify primary and foreign keys in a two-table schema such as students and classes.

skills.name: SELECT and WHERE
skills.description: Give the rows returned by a SELECT with a WHERE and ORDER BY on a small table.

skills.name: Joins and aggregates
skills.description: Compute the result of a simple JOIN or COUNT/AVG with GROUP BY.

skills.name: JavaScript arrays and functions
skills.description: Predict results of map, filter and arrow functions, e.g. [1,2,3].map(x => x * 2).

skills.name: Forms and validation
skills.description: Choose the check that validates an input, e.g. a required email field matching a pattern.

skills.name: APIs and JSON
skills.description: Read a value from a JSON response, e.g. data.user.name, and identify a GET vs POST request.

skills.name: Responsive and accessible design
skills.description: Pick the fix that improves accessibility or mobile layout, e.g. alt text, contrast, media queries.

skills.name: Attack vectors
skills.description: Match SQL injection, cross-site scripting, DDoS and ransomware to descriptions and defences.

skills.name: Secure coding
skills.description: Choose the safer code, e.g. parameterised queries over string concatenation.

skills.name: Network defences
skills.description: Match firewalls, VPNs, authentication and updates to the risks they reduce.

skills.name: Software licences
skills.description: Decide what a licence allows, e.g. MIT vs GPL vs proprietary, for a given reuse.

skills.name: Surveillance trade-offs
skills.description: Evaluate a technology like facial recognition in public and identify the benefits and harms claimed.

skills.name: Global access and equity
skills.description: Identify barriers to computing access worldwide and solutions such as offline-first design.

skills.name: Higher-order functions
skills.description: Evaluate map, filter, reduce and lambdas, e.g. sum of squares of evens from a list.

skills.name: Recursion vs iteration
skills.description: Convert between recursive and iterative solutions and identify the base case.

skills.name: Files and parsing
skills.description: Predict the result of reading lines from a text or CSV file and parsing them.

skills.name: Debugging strategies
skills.description: Read a stack trace or failing test and choose the root cause.

skills.name: Binary trees
skills.description: Give in-order, pre-order or post-order traversal of a small tree or insert into a BST.

skills.name: BFS and DFS
skills.description: List the visit order of breadth-first or depth-first search from a start node.

skills.name: Shortest paths
skills.description: Run Dijkstra's algorithm on a small weighted graph and give the distance to a node.

skills.name: Greedy and dynamic programming
skills.description: Decide whether greedy works for a problem (coin change) and fill a small DP table.

skills.name: Types of learning
skills.description: Classify a task as supervised, unsupervised or reinforcement learning, e.g. spam filter is supervised.

skills.name: Training and testing
skills.description: Explain why data is split, read a confusion matrix and compute accuracy.

skills.name: Simple classifiers
skills.description: Follow a decision tree or k-nearest-neighbours on a small data set to classify a point.

skills.name: Bias and fairness in ML
skills.description: Identify how skewed data or proxy features cause unfair predictions and pick a mitigation.

skills.name: Normalisation
skills.description: Split a table with repeating groups into related tables and identify the keys.

skills.name: Entity relationships
skills.description: Identify one-to-many and many-to-many relationships in a scenario such as orders and products.

skills.name: INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE
skills.description: Give the table state after a sequence of data-modifying SQL statements.

skills.name: Concurrency
skills.description: Identify a race condition in two interleaved threads and pick the fix, e.g. a lock.

skills.name: Process scheduling
skills.description: Compute order or waiting time for processes under first-come-first-served or round-robin.

skills.name: Virtualisation and containers
skills.description: Compare virtual machines and containers and choose which suits a scenario.

skills.name: Routing
skills.description: Use a small routing table to choose the next hop for a destination address.

skills.name: TLS and certificates
skills.description: Order the steps of establishing a secure connection and explain what a certificate proves.

skills.name: Latency and scale
skills.description: Compute latency or bandwidth effects and explain how caching and CDNs speed delivery.

skills.name: AI ethics cases
skills.description: Analyse a case such as automated hiring and identify harms, benefits and accountability.

skills.name: Synthetic media
skills.description: Identify signs and risks of deepfakes and choose verification steps.

skills.name: Data ownership and consent
skills.description: Decide whether a data use matches the consent given and spot dark patterns in consent screens.

skills.name: Version control
skills.description: Order git commands to commit and share a change and resolve what a merge conflict marker means.

skills.name: Unit testing
skills.description: Write or choose an assertion that would catch a given bug, including edge cases.

skills.name: Design principles
skills.description: Identify DRY, single responsibility or encapsulation violations in a snippet and pick the refactor.

skills.name: Development lifecycle
skills.description: Order phases of a sprint or project and match roles to responsibilities.

skills.name: P, NP and intractability
skills.description: Classify problems as tractable or likely intractable and explain why brute force fails at scale.

skills.name: Heuristics and approximation
skills.description: Apply a nearest-neighbour heuristic to a small travelling-salesperson instance and compare to optimal.

skills.name: Hash functions and collisions
skills.description: Compute slots with a simple hash like key mod 7 and resolve a collision with chaining or probing.

skills.name: Linear regression
skills.description: Use a fitted line y = mx + b to predict and compute error for a data point.

skills.name: Neural network basics
skills.description: Compute a single neuron's output from weights, inputs and a step or ReLU activation.

skills.name: Overfitting and generalisation
skills.description: Diagnose overfitting from training vs test accuracy and choose a remedy such as more data.

skills.name: Generative AI literacy
skills.description: Identify what large language models can and cannot reliably do and choose how to verify their output.

skills.name: Data cleaning
skills.description: Spot missing values, duplicates and inconsistent formats in a table and choose the fix.

skills.name: Descriptive statistics
skills.description: Compute median, standard deviation idea and percentiles for a small set and interpret them.

skills.name: Visualisation design
skills.description: Pick the chart that best answers a question and spot misleading visualisations.

skills.name: Client-server flow
skills.description: Order the steps when a form submits: request, server validation, database write, response, render.

skills.name: REST APIs
skills.description: Match HTTP methods and status codes to actions, e.g. DELETE /users/5 returns 204.

skills.name: Authentication and sessions
skills.description: Explain cookies, tokens and sessions and choose the secure handling for a login flow.

skills.name: Threat modelling
skills.description: Identify assets, threats and mitigations for a system such as a school grades portal.

skills.name: Public-key cryptography
skills.description: Perform a small RSA or Diffie-Hellman computation with tiny numbers and explain the shared secret.

skills.name: Incident response
skills.description: Order the steps after a breach: contain, investigate, notify, recover, learn.

skills.name: Technology policy
skills.description: Match regulations and proposals to the problems they address, e.g. net neutrality and content moderation.

skills.name: Sustainable computing
skills.description: Estimate or compare energy use of computing choices and pick greener designs.

skills.name: Professional ethics
skills.description: Apply a code of ethics to a workplace dilemma such as shipping a known security flaw.
